summary: Show Planning help or dispatch Planning subcommands through the workspace front door.

inputs.name: operation_action
inputs.description: Runtime-only action discriminator; route-decision-next-action is admitted by agentic_workspace.workspace_runtime_planning.validate_planning_route_action_invocation.

inputs.name: input_identity
inputs.description: agentic-planning/route-action-input/v1 identity containing route_action, task_relation, owner_posture, expected_transition, planning_revision, selected owner identity/lifecycle/projection, task binding identity/mode, mutation baseline/scope/effects/overlap, implementation permission, mutation authority, state-update policy, claim policy, reconciliation proposal identity/revision, and idempotency_key.

inputs.name: input_revision
inputs.description: sha256 revision of the route action input identity; stale execution is rejected when it differs from the live route decision.

steps.description: Route the generated root planning command to the existing module runtime front door.
Emit module help or delegated command output.

guards: Generated code owns parser/help/dispatch shape; module runtime owns package policy and command effects.
The route-decision-next-action path must pass route-action admission before mutation or claim advancement.
proof: generated command package parser accepts the root front-door command
route-action admission rejects stale owner, task binding, mutation baseline, and reconciliation proposal identity
